card.name: Stated use or purpose of a substance
card.fires_on: Words that complete a statement of what something is used for, such as feed, fuel, sedative or premedication. It also fires on small words like 'as', 'of' or a comma right after a use phrase.

modes.label: Use-as nouns
modes.description: The noun naming the purpose a substance is used for, such as feed or fuel.
modes.example: Corn and soybeans are used primarily for livestock<< feed>>.

modes.label: Sedative or premedication use
modes.description: Part of a dosing line saying a drug is given as a sedative or premedication.

modes.label: Linking words in use phrases
modes.description: A small word or comma after a use phrase, where the purpose continues.
modes.example: It is also a constituent<< of>> wood preservatives
